reviews.text: We hired Pro Spray Refinishing to complete our master bathroom remodel after having a new vanity & Granite countertop installed by another company.  Pro Spray came in to paint our master bedroom, master bath, 2 full guest baths and do some other finish work for us.  They fixed the tile gaps at the end of the new vanity, hung up 4 new light fixtures, installed a new toilet, and hung up new mirrors for us.  They were great to work with and did a terrific job.  We are so happy with our new bathroom makeover & will be using them for additional painting in the future! The price was fair & the work was excellent! We would definitely recommend them.

Herb and Shawna were here today to repaint the interior of our screened in porch, which hasn’t been done since we moved in 10 years ago. The did a very professional and thorough job at a very reasonable price and we are extremely happy. If you have any work that you need done do not hesitate to call them. Again thank you Herb and Shawna for an exceptional paint job.

We had Herb and Shawna back today(11/4) to spray paint 4 chairs and 2 benches and they did a fantastic job, so glad we found a company that is professional and reliable.
